name: Email
showcaseSub: Showcase transport: nothing is sent and nothing is checked with a real provider.
title: Email sending
sub: Who your email comes from, whether your domain is verified, and who you must not email.
deniedBody: Email settings are for people who can manage integrations. Your role is {role}.
deniedSupport: Email settings are not available in a support session.
loadErrorBody: The email settings could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
notConnectedBody: Connect your own Resend account or your own mail server. Your credentials are stored encrypted and never shown again.
identityHelp: Every email carries these details. They belong to your business and are not shared with any other workspace.
fromEmailHelp: Must be on a domain you control and have verified below.
footerHelp: Your business name and postal address. Shown under every email, above the unsubscribe link.
dkimSelectorHelp: The selector your mail provider gave you (the part before ._domainkey). Needed to check DKIM for an SMTP server.
domainHelp: SPF and DKIM prove to inbox providers that you allow this system to send as your domain. Add the records below at your DNS host.
domainCheckFailed: The domain could not be checked right now. The last known state is still shown.
domainNoSender: Enter a sender address first, then check the domain.
domainShowcaseNote: Showcase: this connection never talks to a provider, so no domain is verified.
domainSmtpNote: SMTP: we look up your DNS records ourselves. A record being present is shown as found, not as proof that your mail server may send for it.
webhookHelp: In Resend, add a webhook with this URL and tick delivered, bounced and complained. Then paste the signing secret Resend shows you.
webhookSecretHelp: Starts with whsec_. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
webhookSecretMissing: No signing secret yet: bounces and complaints are not being received.
webhookSmtpNote: SMTP servers do not send events here. Addresses the server refuses while sending are added to the suppression list; later bounces arrive in your own mailbox.
suppressionHelp: These addresses are never emailed. Hard bounces, spam complaints and unsubscribes are added automatically.
suppressionMissing: The suppression list is not available yet on this workspace. Unsubscribes and complaints are still honoured through consent.
mailchimp.title: Mailchimp audience
mailchimp.help: Contacts who agreed to marketing email are pushed to the audience you choose. People who unsubscribe or bounce in Mailchimp are brought back here and blocked.
mailchimp.audiencesFailed: Mailchimp audiences could not be loaded.
mailchimp.pushHelp: Only contacts with marketing-email consent are sent. Others are skipped and counted.
mailchimp.pushQueuedSub: {count} contacts queued. Contacts without consent are skipped at send time.
mailchimp.hookHelp: Without this, unsubscribes and bounces are pulled every 30 minutes. To get them at once, add this URL under Audience, Webhooks in Mailchimp and tick Unsubscribes and Cleaned.
mailchimp.hookOnce: Copy it now. It contains a secret and is not shown again.
mailchimp.demoNote: Showcase: nothing is pushed to Mailchimp.
unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from email
unsubscribe.ready: Confirm that you no longer want to receive marketing email from this sender. This takes effect immediately.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will not receive marketing email from this sender any more. It can take a short while for mail already queued to stop.
unsubscribe.expiredBody: For your safety unsubscribe links stop working after a while. Use the link in a more recent email from the sender, or reply to ask to be removed.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: The link is incomplete or has been changed. Use the unsubscribe link in the email again, or reply to the sender to ask to be removed.
unsubscribe.unavailableBody: This is a demonstration environment. No email is sent from here, so there is nothing to unsubscribe from.
unsubscribe.error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
